Branding

The Grove Media

We delivered a complete rebrand with a new website, repositioning The Grove Media from a small company with a loyal client base, to an independent agency disrupting the industry with a different kind of planning & buying.

The work

Invention

Real World Media

For non-corporate advertisers today’s media buying agencies aren’t fit for purpose. They need a personal relationship with a company who understands how their business works and their customers think. The Grove Media are the answer, but their brand was stuck in the past.

The visual identity speaks to the symbiotic relationship between client and their agency and the fresh but professional colour palette reflects their non-corporate personality. Whilst the messaging approach is everything The Grove Media are, straightforward, personable, smart-thinking and knowledgeable.
